ns2:section.sectionText: Volunteer Experience in Cape Town, South Africa. Eight-week preparatory course examines history, economy, and political events leading up to the demise of the apartheid system, including the role of African youth in the struggle. Experience in Cape Town includes intensive study, discussion, field trips and experience with local cultural events. Final two weeks in South Africa include work with community organizations that provide education and support for women and care for children orphaned by the AIDS crisis. Instructor approval required -contact the instructor Jan Brooks at dickson@uiuc.edu or the ACES Study Abroad Office at 333-3638 for application. Application required by April 25, 2008. Additional fee approximately $4,000.00. Travel dates December 27, 2008 through January 17, 2009. 3 credit hours.
